# Pesher Psalms Column 4 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** 4QpPs (4Q171), Col. 4 | **Condition:** moderate to heavy damage

---

**4:1** "The LORD loves justice and never abandons His loyal ones; they are kept safe

**4:2** forever, but the children of the wicked will be destroyed" (Psalm 37:28).

**4:3** This speaks of [...] the Teacher of Righteousness and those who carry out [...] God's will.

**4:4** [...] He will never abandon them [...] and the children of the wicked [...]

**4:5** will be cut off forever.

**4:6** "The righteous will possess the land and live in it

**4:7** forever" (Psalm 37:29).

**4:8** This speaks of [...] for a thousand generations [...]

**4:9** to them and their descendants will belong the whole inheritance of humanity,

**4:10** and to their descendants forever.

**4:11** [...] the holy heights of Is[rael...].

**4:12** "The wicked spy on the righteous, looking for a chance to kill them.

**4:13** But the LORD will not let them fall into their power or be found guilty when

**4:14** they stand trial" (Psalm 37:32-33).

**4:15** This speaks of the Wicked [Priest] who spied on the [Teacher of Righteous]ness and tried

**4:16** to kill him [...] and the instruction he had sent him. But God will not abandon him and will not

**4:17** [let him be condemned at] his trial. God will punish the Wicked Priest by handing him over

**4:18** to ruthless foreign powers to carry out [judgment] upon him [...]

---

*PNEUMA notes: Dynamic rendering of 4Q171, Col. 4. "Saints" rendered as "loyal ones" for accessibility. "Seed" rendered as "children/descendants." "Inheritance of Adam" rendered as "inheritance of humanity" — the Hebrew adam can be read as "humankind." "Torah which he sent" rendered as "instruction he had sent" — torah here means authoritative teaching, likely a halakhic letter. The climactic passage (4:15-18) narrates the conflict between the Wicked Priest and the Teacher of Righteousness — the central drama of the Qumran scrolls.*
